newsitem.title: JAPAN: All months of Tokyo corn futures end higher.
newsitem.headline: All months of Tokyo corn futures end higher.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Monday on buying by local investors encouraged by the yen's stronger sentiment against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 50 to 190 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract up 150 yen at 14,210 yen per tonne. Volume was 46,238 lots.

The market was mixed in the early morning, as the stronger yen against the dollar offset price falls on the CBOT market on Friday, the traders said. By late afternoon, technical buying by individual investors supported the market, they said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.76 per bushel at 0810 GMT, against $2.75-1/4 at Friday's close.
The spot November CBOT soybean futures contract was at $7.04-3/4 at 0810 GMT, up from $7.00 at Friday's close.
